mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_TRMA_NOTIFICATION (USER_ID, TYPE_CD, TITLE, CONTENT, PARAM1, PARAM2, LINK_URL, IS_READ, CREATE_DT) SELECT a.CREATE_USER ,'APPLY' ,'새로운 참가 신청이 있어요' ,CONCAT(b.USER_NM, '님이 "', a.MOIM_TITLE, '"에 참가 신청했습니다.') ,b.USER_NM ,a.MOIM_TITLE ,CONCAT('/moimManage/', #{moimId}) ,'N' ,CURRENT_TIMESTAMP FROM TB_TRMA_MOIM_LIST a LEFT JOIN TB_TRMA_USER_INFO b ON b.USER_ID = #{applicantUserId} WHERE a.MOIM_ID = #{moimId}

INSERT INTO TB_TRMA_NOTIFICATION (USER_ID, TYPE_CD, TITLE, CONTENT, PARAM1, LINK_URL, IS_READ, CREATE_DT) SELECT #{userId} ,'COMPLETE' ,'여행이 완료되었어요' ,CONCAT('"', a.MOIM_TITLE, '" 여행이 종료되었습니다. 후기를 남겨보세요!') ,a.MOIM_TITLE ,CONCAT('/moim/', a.MOIM_ID, '/review') ,'N' ,CURRENT_TIMESTAMP FROM TB_TRMA_MOIM_LIST a INNER JOIN TB_TRMA_MOIM_MEMBER b ON a.MOIM_ID = b.MOIM_ID AND b.USER_ID = #{userId} AND b.STATE_CD = 'Y' WHERE a.MOIM_END_DT < CURDATE() AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TB_TRMA_NOTIFICATION n WHERE n.USER_ID = #{userId} AND n.TYPE_CD = 'COMPLETE' AND n.LINK_URL = CONCAT('/moim/', a.MOIM_ID, '/review') )
mapper.select: SELECT NOTI_ID ,TYPE_CD ,TITLE ,CONTENT ,PARAM1 ,PARAM2 ,LINK_URL ,IS_READ ,CREATE_DT FROM TB_TRMA_NOTIFICATION WHERE USER_ID = #{userId} ORDER BY CREATE_DT DESC LIMIT 50
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM TB_TRMA_NOTIFICATION WHERE USER_ID = #{userId} AND IS_READ = 'N'
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_TRMA_NOTIFICATION SET IS_READ = 'Y' WHERE USER_ID = #{userId} AND TYPE_CD = 'CHAT' AND LINK_URL = CONCAT('/chat/', #{roomId}) AND IS_READ = 'N'
UPDATE TB_TRMA_NOTIFICATION SET IS_READ = 'Y' WHERE USER_ID = #{userId} AND TYPE_CD = 'APPLY' AND LINK_URL = CONCAT('/moimManage/', #{moimId}) AND IS_READ = 'N'
